description: This file defines the PdfTableAttributes class, which represents a set of attributes for PDF table elements within the PDFsharp library. It includes properties for table cell spanning such as row and column spans, and manages associated keys.

classes.name: PdfTableAttributes
classes.description: Represents PDF table attributes, including cell span properties, and is part of the PdfSharp.Pdf.Structure namespace.

methods.name: PdfTableAttributes()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes a new instance and sets ownership properties.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with an owning PdfDocument.

methods.name: SetOwner()
methods.description: Sets the owner of the PdfTableAttributes elements, specifically setting the element name to '/Table'.
